Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary — this is helpful. A few items from procurement/finance: 

- Commercial path: For pilots under $25k we usually pay by corporate card; for anything above that we require a PO + Net 30. The pilot will likely be ~monthly usage and could go above $25k if we scale.

- Marketplace: We prefer direct invoicing so we can track spend against internal cost centers; marketplace fees complicate billing. So direct invoice + PO is preferred.

- Invoice requirements / billing details:
  • Billing name: Acme Analytics Ltd
  • Billing address: Acme Analytics Ltd, Accounts Payable, 123 Market St, London, EC1 1AA, United Kingdom
  • VAT ID: GB123456789
  • PO number: Our PO numbers are 10 digits prefixed with ACME- (e.g., ACME-0000123456)
  • Line items: We require a per-line breakdown with unit price, quantity, and a total; tax/VAT must be shown separately.

Can you provide a sample invoice in PDF and the invoice template your AP team uses? Also please include any payment remittance instructions (bank details) for Redwood.

I’ll loop in our Procurement mailbox if we need to get a PO raised: procurement@acmeanalytics.com

Thanks — Elena
Director of Finance | Acme Analytics
elena.ruiz@acmeanalytics.com
